job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




Strong proficiency in Java programming language.
Extensive experience in developing MicroServices using Java frameworks.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services.
Proficient in using Python, Django, FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, PostgreSQL, AWS, PyCharm.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
Knowledge of database technologies such as SQL and NoSQL.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile teams.
Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., ELK stack, Prometheus)

Preferred candidate profile

JAVA, J2EE , DB(Mongo), Microservices, Spring boot, Hibernate, Kubernetes with AWS

Python, Django, FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, PostgreSQL, AWS, PyCharm




Perks and benefits
